findings.finding: The source does not identify which queue item is shared or define what state counts as final, so the proposed verification cannot establish the requested outcome.
findings.source_support: The contract does not define which queue item is shared or what state counts as final.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The proposal selects the first visible item and treats Done as final without support from the source.

findings.finding: The proposal verifies only the status; it omits preserving the assigned Owner and recording one audit entry.
findings.source_support: preserve its assigned Owner, and add one audit entry recording the status change.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: No verification clause checks that the Owner is preserved or that exactly one audit entry was added.

findings.finding: The proposal checks only the current settings view and does not verify that the disabled state persists after closing and reopening settings.
findings.source_support: After closing and reopening the endpoint settings, E-2 must remain disabled.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The required close-and-reopen persistence check is absent.

findings.finding: The two values are not verified on the same R-22 record: Status is checked in detail view, while Owner is checked on an unspecified record in compact view.
findings.source_support: the same record ID R-22 must show both values
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify both Status=Approved and Owner=Lee for R-22 in each required view after reopening.

findings.finding: The proposal checks that record IDs remain present, which does not verify that every other record is unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other record must be unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The proposal does not compare other records’ prior and resulting values.

findings.finding: The proposal returns FAIL when the independent source is unavailable, contrary to the required UNKNOWN result.
findings.source_support: If the independent validation source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not claim either success or failure.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source handling must return UNKNOWN; the proposal specifies FAIL.

findings.finding: The source identifies three highlighted tasks but provides no rule for choosing one, so it does not support selecting the first highlighted task.
findings.source_support: there are three highlighted tasks, and the request gives no rule for choosing among them.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The proposed verification assumes the first highlighted task is the selected task.

findings.finding: The proposal checks the new binding after relaunch but omits checking that existing shortcuts were not changed.
findings.source_support: No existing shortcut may be changed.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify that all pre-existing shortcuts retain their prior bindings.

findings.finding: The proposal returns FAIL when the source is unavailable instead of UNKNOWN and does not address the required prohibition on submitting the release in that condition.
findings.source_support: If that source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not submit the release.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source handling must return UNKNOWN and ensure no release is submitted; the proposal specifies FAIL and does not verify the submission gate.

findings.finding: After reopening, the proposal checks an unspecified document rather than confirming that D-41 remains Approved.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The post-reopen check must identify D-41.

findings.finding: An unchanged total document count does not establish that every other document remained unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other document must remain unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The proposal does not compare other documents’ prior and resulting values.

findings.finding: The proposed check targets C-140, while the requested customer is C-104.
findings.source_support: For customer C-104, change the contact email to kai@example.test.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify the email change on C-104.

findings.finding: The proposal omits checking the constraint against editing other customers.
findings.source_support: No other customer may be edited.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify that no other customer was edited.

findings.finding: The proposed verification adds a payment-card preservation requirement that the source does not request.
findings.source_support: No request was made about payment or billing settings.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Remove the payment-card check; the source contract concerns only the display name.
